publishedfiledetails.title: VVE - Secondary Weapons
publishedfiledetails.description:
[h2]Vanilla Vehicles Expanded - Secondary Weapons addon[/h2]

Adds secondary weapons into [url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/?id=3014906877]VVE[/url] combat vehicles, and then some.
Recommended to use with [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3302208420]Vanilla Vehicles Expanded - Upgrades[/url] for Tier 1 vehicle upgrades.

Compatible with:
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/?id=2890901044]Combat Extended[/url]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3047892432]Vanilla Vehicles Expanded - Tier 3[/url]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3468971796]VVE: Tier 3 Upgrades[/url]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/?id=2803605709][LTS]Ammunition - Simple Ammo Pack[/url]

[b]Warning[/b]: Since a few combat vehicles now spawn with machine guns on top of their main cannon with no extra penalty, this mod may make them too unbalanced. This mod was created with other vehicle mods in mind, in which a tank comes with at least one machine gun plus its main cannon.

[h2]Added content[/h2]

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3385339392]All Vanilla Vehicles Expanded + Tier 3 vehicles now come with basic upgrades. Original version link here.[/url]

Tier 1 ([url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3302208420]VVE:Upgrades required[/url])
[list]
[*]Roadkill and Bunsen - default with coaxial MG
[*]Dinghy - various weapon options
[*]Mule - bed seats default + various weapon options
[/list]

Tier 2
[list]
[*]Roadrunner - bed seats default + various weapon options
[*]Wisent - Gun truck or self-propelled artillery conversion
[*]Bulldog - default with bow and coaxial MG + pintle HMG option
[*]Tango - Badger turret upgrade option
[*]Trawler - default with back seats + front/rear weapon options
[/list]

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3047892432]Tier 3[/url]
[list]
[*]Badger - default with coaxial MG with no extra upgrade options
[*]Cherokee - door gun options
[*]Louie - door gun options
[*]Marshal - default with coaxial MG
[*]Nomad - roof weapon options
[*]Paladin - turret replacement options, different grenade types for using without CE
[*]Udar - optional bow-mounted autocannon
[/list]

[h2]Mods[/h2]

[*]For CE, ammo types that upgrades or secondary weapons use are now in vehicle descriptions.
[*]For CE with ammo disabled, vehicles in general are not compatible with it. I tried to implement a setting feature, but I couldn't get it to work at all. If I remember correctly, vehicle turrets will function but still require reloading with non-generic ammo instead of materials like steel.
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3302208420]VVE:Upgrades[/url] isn't a hard requirement, but I highly recommend it if you want to upgrade Tier 1 vehicles with new weaponry. This is to simplify compatibility.

[h2]Credits[/h2]
[list]
[*]Rimworld
[*]Combat Extended Team - Turret textures from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/?id=2890901044]the Combat Extended mod itself[/url]. The only part I made are gun shields.
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2884367441]CE+ CZARsenal[/url] - DShK, Maxim machine guns
[*]Vanilla Expanded Team - UI icons and vehicle turret textures.
[*]GrahammerTek - Carl Gustaf, M134 and vanilla bullets from the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3410965054]Ford F-150 mod[/url].
[*]Froffy - [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3385339392]More Vanilla Vehicles Expanded Upgrades[/url] which has been merged into this mod.
[*]Bonible - Machine gun sounds from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2999509683]Modded Weapon Sound Replacement Pack[/url].
[*]Smash Phil - [url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/?id=3014915404]Vehicle Framework[/url].
[/list]
I do not claim ownership on any of the reused assets within this mod! One could say this mod doesn't really "add" anything new, but only uses already existing things. I originally made this mod for personal use thinking it would be rather niche, but it blew up in popularity thanks to everyone! Thank you very much for your support!

If there are any suggestions, questions or problems, let me know down in the comments section below!
